title: Wide Board with Open Highback Bindings
description: One original complete static snowboard with a single continuous wide sidecut board, lifted blunt ends, dark running base and two transverse open highback bindings. Each whole binding has an inset footbed, a curved heel-back shell rising behind an empty foot bay, two genuinely arched thick straps and fixed side buckles. The wide shared board and cross-board highback strap structure are not a quantity or width edit of the earlier separate alpine skis with toe and heel release housings. One model, zero scenes; no boots, rider, logos or loose accessories. Static visual only: no riding, turning, snow interaction, release system, binding adjustment, wearable fit, compatibility, load or sports-safety certification.
